## mysql

MySQL through the platform API (Crossplane MySQL XR): MOCO in-cluster (MySQL 8.4, semi-sync replication for HA). Needs a data plane that runs addons crossplane and moco. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-resource-types/mysql.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-resource-types/mysql.yaml). Needs data-plane addons: crossplane,moco.

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `database` | string |  | `app` | Database to create; the app user has the same name. Immutable. Range ..32 chars. Pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`. |
| `version` | string |  | `8.4` | MySQL LTS version. Upgrades only. One of `8.4`. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | Cloud backends only (layout). One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |
| `highAvailability` | boolean |  | `false` | 3 instances with semi-sync replication and automatic failover. Required in production (admission policy). |
| `size` | string |  | `S` | Compute of each mysqld instance. One of `S`, `M`, `L`. |
| `storageGiB` | integer |  | `10` | Storage per instance in GiB; can grow, never shrink. Range 10..16384. |

### outputs

| Output | Delivered as |
|---|---|
| `host` | value |
| `port` | value |
| `database` | value |
| `username` | secretKeyRef `username` |
| `password` | secretKeyRef `password` |
| `uri` | secretKeyRef `uri` |

## postgresql

PostgreSQL through the platform API (Crossplane PostgreSQL XR): CloudNativePG in-cluster, RDS / Aurora, Cloud SQL or Azure Flexible Server in the cloud, chosen by the cluster. Needs a data plane that runs addon crossplane. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-resource-types/postgresql.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/files/platform/cluster-resource-types/postgresql.yaml). Needs data-plane addons: crossplane.

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `database` | string |  | `app` | Database to create; its owner role has the same name (output username). Immutable. Range ..63 chars. Pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`. |
| `version` | string |  | `17` | PostgreSQL major version. Upgrades only (no downgrade). One of `16`, `17`, `18`. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `backup` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `backup.enabled` | boolean |  | `false` | Automated backups with point-in-time recovery. Required in production (admission policy). |
| `backup.retentionDays` | integer |  | `7` | Range 7..35. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | Cloud backends - Retain keeps the database when the XR is deleted (deletion protection on). One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |
| `highAvailability` | boolean |  | `false` | Standby in another zone with automatic failover. Required in production (admission policy). |
| `size` | string |  | `S` | Compute of each instance (CNPG resources, RDS / Cloud SQL / Flexible Server class). One of `S`, `M`, `L`. |
| `storageGiB` | integer |  | `10` | Storage per instance in GiB; can grow, never shrink. Range 10..16384. |

### outputs

| Output | Delivered as |
|---|---|
| `host` | value |
| `port` | value |
| `database` | value |
| `username` | secretKeyRef `username` |
| `password` | secretKeyRef `password` |
| `uri` | secretKeyRef `uri` |

## bucket

S3-compatible bucket through the platform API (Crossplane Bucket XR): RustFS in-cluster, S3 / GCS / Azure Blob in the cloud, chosen by the cluster. Cloud apps authenticate with workload identity. Needs addon crossplane. Source: [packages/bucket/openchoreo/cluster-resource-type.yaml](../../packages/bucket/openchoreo/cluster-resource-type.yaml). **Not deployed yet**: the API package is still a layout; the file moves into the chart when enabled. Needs data-plane addons: crossplane.

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `versioning` | boolean |  | `false` |  |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storageGiB` | integer |  | `10` | Range 1..4096. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### outputs

| Output | Delivered as |
|---|---|
| `endpoint` | value |
| `bucket` | value |
| `region` | secretKeyRef `region` |
| `accessKeyId` | secretKeyRef `accessKeyId` |
| `secretAccessKey` | secretKeyRef `secretAccessKey` |

## kafka-topic

Kafka topic with credentials through the platform API (Crossplane KafkaTopic XR): Strimzi in-cluster, Event Hubs (MSK / Managed Kafka: VERIFY) in the cloud, chosen by the cluster. Needs addon crossplane on the data plane. Source: [packages/kafka-topic/openchoreo/cluster-resource-type.yaml](../../packages/kafka-topic/openchoreo/cluster-resource-type.yaml). **Not deployed yet**: the API package is still a layout; the file moves into the chart when enabled. Needs data-plane addons: crossplane.

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `partitions` | integer |  | `3` | Range 1..100. |
| `cleanupPolicy` | string |  | `delete` | One of `delete`, `compact`. |

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `retentionHours` | integer |  | `168` | Range 1..8760. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### outputs

| Output | Delivered as |
|---|---|
| `bootstrapServers` | value |
| `topic` | value |
| `securityProtocol` | secretKeyRef `securityProtocol` |
| `saslMechanism` | secretKeyRef `saslMechanism` |
| `username` | secretKeyRef `username` |
| `password` | secretKeyRef `password` |

## valkey

Valkey (Redis-compatible) through the platform API (Crossplane Valkey XR): valkey-operator in-cluster, ElastiCache / Memorystore / Azure Cache in the cloud, chosen by the cluster. Needs addon crossplane on the data plane. Source: [packages/valkey/openchoreo/cluster-resource-type.yaml](../../packages/valkey/openchoreo/cluster-resource-type.yaml). **Not deployed yet**: the API package is still a layout; the file moves into the chart when enabled. Needs data-plane addons: crossplane.

### parameters

No fields.

### environmentConfigs

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | string |  | `S` | One of `S`, `M`, `L`. |
| `highAvailability` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `maxmemoryPolicy` | string |  | `noeviction` | One of `noeviction`, `allkeys-lru`, `volatile-lru`, `allkeys-lfu`. |
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Retain` | One of `Retain`, `Delete`. |

### outputs

| Output | Delivered as |
|---|---|
| `host` | value |
| `port` | value |
| `tls` | value |
| `username` | secretKeyRef `username` |
| `password` | secretKeyRef `password` |
